title: Every Bière & Code, so far.
intro: The conversations continue. This archive brings together every past gathering from our original Meetup group and our Luma calendar. Upcoming events and registration are on Luma.
historyIntro: Original event records from Meetup and Luma, newest first. Events published on both platforms appear once. RSVP counts are the numbers each platform showed, not verified attendance.
limitationsBody: Public group and event content only. Individual member and guest lists are not republished. Luma does not publish event photo galleries, so photos come from the Meetup albums. Original descriptions are preserved in their original language; dates use the event’s recorded timezone.
eventNotice: This is a historical record, not an event invitation. For current gatherings, visit our Luma calendar.
cancelledNotice: Meetup marked this event as cancelled. It is preserved here as part of the historical record.
exportNote: The archive is stored with this website, including local copies of the images. No Meetup or Luma account is needed to browse it.
